configurations.name: legends-api
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 20 && cd apps/api && DATABASE_URL='postgresql://legends:legends@localhost:5432/legends?schema=public' JWT_SECRET='dev-secret-change-me' PORT=3334 pnpm exec tsx watch src/server.ts

configurations.name: legends-web
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 20 && cd apps/web && VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:3334 pnpm exec vite --port 5175 --strictPort
